name: Twin Towns Services Community Foundation Scholarship (SCU Gold Coast)
summary: $5,000 for a Tweed or Gold Coast resident starting a full-time bachelor degree at SCU's Gold Coast campus.
who: Live in the Tweed Shire or Gold Coast City Council area.
Starting a full-time bachelor degree at the Gold Coast campus.
Strong academic results and community contribution.
how: Apply through SCU's applying for a scholarship page.
catches: Priority for applicants living from Burleigh Heads south to the Tweed border.

source.label: Southern Cross University: Twin Towns Community Foundation Scholarship

evidence.quote: Reside within the boundaries of the Tweed Shire and Gold Coast City Council local government areas.
